en.description: Expands @path imports in instruction files and injects the referenced files at session start.
en.filesHint: One path per line, relative to the session working directory or absolute.
en.injectOnHint: Session-start events that trigger injection. Unchecking every event restores the default (all).
en.instructionFilesHint: One file name per line. These files are scanned for imports but not re-injected.
en.invalidNumber: Enter a number, or leave blank to use the default.
en.invalidTokens: Use only: startup, resume, clear, compact.
en.maxDepthHint: How many levels of nested @imports to follow.
en.maxFileBytesHint: Larger files are truncated at this size.
en.maxTotalBytesHint: Files that would exceed the budget are omitted.
en.saveFailed: The deployment did not accept these values; they were left for you to correct.
en.scanImportsHint: Follow @path references found in AGENTS.md and the other instruction files below.
en.templateHint: Optional. Use {{content}} where the injected files should appear; empty uses the default wrapper.
en.title: Context imports
en.unavailable: This plugin is not loaded, so it cannot be configured right now.
